During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a '''skirmish''' between the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] occurred above the planet of [[Javaal]]. The skirmish was the result of imperial ships ambushing a Republic patrol group. The Imperials were led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Kestas Rone]], callsign "Bloodletter", who commanded the deadly [[Razor Shyracks]] squadron. The skirmish was resolved when pilots of the [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron came to the aid of the patrol group and destroyed the Imperial attackers, including the Shyracks. The remainder of the Imperial fleet was also heavily damaged.<ref name="Saleucami Fleet Action" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of Javaal appears as Javaal Fleet Action, one of the Space Missions available in the MMO ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Republic players are called in to destroy a minimum of five Mk VII interceptors and the single X-70B Phantom. There is some conflicting information regarding the identity of the [[X-70B Phantom-class prototype|X-70B Phantom's]] pilot. The Space Combat mission in the games galaxy map refers to him as an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]], whilst the mission dispatch for [[Operation Searing Light]] identifies the pilot as Sith Lord Kestas Rone.<ref name="Saleucami Fleet Action" />
